name: Mata Atlântica Viva: conservation and regeneration call
summary: Grants of up to R$60,000 for Brazilian community non-profits restoring and protecting the Atlantic Forest, including spring and watershed revegetation and agroforestry. The 2026 call was the third since 2023 and is closed.
reporting: A final report and financial accounts, due by 30 July 2027.
